---
title: "R Markdown in Notdown"
output: html_document
params:
  count: 5
external_field: preserved
---

## Shared variables and inline R

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
values <- seq_len(params$count)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

The sum is `r sum(values)`.

## Table

```{r table, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(data.frame(value = values, square = values^2))
```

## Plot

```{r chart, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=3, fig.cap="Values and squares"}
plot(values, values^2, type = "b", col = "steelblue")
```

## Skipped code

```{r skipped, eval=FALSE}
stop("This chunk must not run")
```

## Markdown generated by R

```{r generated, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat("**中文结果：** ", sum(values), "\n", sep = "")
```
